_doc: mcp-obsidian via Obsidian Local REST API community plugin. Clone: ~/GitHub/mcp-obsidian. Do not commit real OBSIDIAN_API_KEY.
prereqs: Install Obsidian community plugin: Local REST API (coddingtonbear)
Enable plugin; copy API key from plugin settings
Default host 127.0.0.1 port 27124 (HTTPS plugin default may differ — check plugin UI)
Confirm vault path for this host (skill may still say /mnt/d/Obsidian Vault/AI Research/)

catalog_split_pattern.detect: Notes > ~800 lines or multi-topic H1/H2 sections
catalog_split_pattern.index: Index notes as lists of [[wikilinks]] (vault skill: flat + links > deep folders)
catalog_split_pattern.reference_map: Trailing Related section and/or frontmatter related: [[A]], [[B]]
catalog_split_pattern.optional_graph: Understand-Anything /understand-knowledge after indexes exist; Hister local-file index for semantic vault search without Obsidian open

_enable: Set OBSIDIAN_API_KEY in shell or OpenCode environment; flip enabled true; restart client.
